description: Holds the page at a phone, tablet or desktop width, and leaves it there. Every tool afterwards, including the numbered map, the accessibility audit and the measurements, then answers about that width, which is how you find what is wrong at 375px rather than just noticing that something is. Call it with reset to give the page back. Chrome shows a debugging banner while this is held; that is Chrome, not the page.

reset.description: Hand the page back at its real size.

name: set_viewport
title: Show the page at another width
